name: Elune's Cradle places its visible healing area around the enemy (#7531)
contract: #7531: with Aspect of the Goddess, Warden's Blade casts Elune's Cradle 807992 on its target. Spell.dbc makes 807992 a persistent area aura (effect 27) with spell visual 2911, centred on the enemy (TargetA TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ENEMY) and applying a periodic heal (aura 8, every 3 sec) to allies inside it (TargetB TARGET_UNIT_DEST_AREA_ALLY, radius index 13, 10 yd), lasting duration index 29 (12 sec). The client draws the area from that dynamic object, so the cast must create a dynamic object for 807992 that lives about 12 sec, and a wounded group member standing 5 yd from the enemy must receive 807992's periodic heal as a buff. Because TargetA is an enemy, the positivity heuristic classifies the heal as negative unless spell_custom_attr marks effect 0 positive. Warden's Blade itself only selects 807992 by aspect; this fixture casts 807992 directly on the enemy.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Wound the ally so the periodic heal has room
DISCRIMINATING: the cast places the area the client draws
The area lasts the spell's 12 sec
CONTROL: the group member 5 yd from the enemy receives the periodic heal
DISCRIMINATING: the healing aura reaches the ally as a buff, not a debuff
